knowledgator_gliclass_v4_9b.disclosure: First measurement of knowledgator/gliclass-v4-9b, a GLiClass model compatible with Jev-style decisions. Fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B: a decoder reads the question, a small recurrent DeBERTa-style scorer reads option labels, and a calibrator supplies native choice, noul and score probabilities. No generated explanation. scx-admin/Apex-large is a byte-identical republish of this checkpoint; the original repository was measured and the republish receives no separate row. The card's own serving configuration ran unchanged. Requests beyond the 32,768-token joint limit are refused before a forward pass. Of 1,500 requests, 1,485 answered and 15 returned HTTP 422 length refusals, scored as misses. No answered request was truncated. Native input usage equals an independent count on all answered requests; output is zero. No decision exceeded 10 s; loopback p95 was 0.25 s and maximum 0.48 s. The share view applies the common self-hosted latency assumption, twice measured p50 plus 0.15 s. A separate synthetic 32,768-token probe took 10.3–10.7 s on this hardware; the scored requests did not test performance near that length. Determinism record: 50/50 bit-identical repeat responses, zero argmax flips. The multimodal tower was loaded but no images were used. Card training-data statements and reported scores were not independently verified; training overlap with JevBench was not checked. Weights and base Apache-2.0; the original pinned repository has no separate LICENSE file, while the byte-identical republish includes the canonical Apache-2.0 text. One measured attempt; an earlier hardware create call failed before an instance existed.
